pages.text: $(bold)Durandal Shard$()$(br2)Obtaining: when a player slays the $(bold)Wither$(), a $(bold)25%$() chance to drop 1-2.$(br2)Usage: smelt it → $(bold)Molten Durandal$(), used to craft the $(l:materials/material_durandal)Durandal material$(), from which the $(l:tools/tool_durandal_sword)Durandal Sword$() is forged.
